title: Introduction to Chemical Reactions
description: Learn the basics of chemical reactions and how to predict products

steps.title: Understanding Elements
steps.content: Click on elements in the periodic table to select them. Each element has unique properties.

steps.title: Combining Elements
steps.content: Select Sodium (Na) and Chlorine (Cl) from the periodic table.

steps.title: Setting Conditions
steps.content: Adjust the temperature to 400K to provide activation energy.

steps.title: Run Simulation
steps.content: Click Run Simulation to see the reaction occur and observe the formation of NaCl.

objectives: Understand what a chemical reaction is
Learn to predict simple ionic compounds

title: Exploring Molecular Structure
description: Visualize 3D molecular structures and understand geometry

steps.title: 3D Visualization
steps.content: Observe how atoms arrange in 3D space. The visualization shows particles moving based on temperature.

steps.title: Molecular Geometry
steps.content: Create water (H2O) by selecting hydrogen and oxygen. Notice the bent geometry.

steps.title: Understanding Bonds
steps.content: Watch how atoms form bonds. The blue lines show bonding interactions.

steps.title: Temperature Effects
steps.content: Increase temperature and see how particle motion increases.

objectives: See how temperature affects molecular motion

title: Organic Chemistry Basics
description: Introduction to organic molecules and functional groups

steps.title: Carbon Chemistry
steps.content: Carbon forms the basis of organic chemistry with its ability to form 4 bonds.

steps.title: Functional Groups
steps.content: Learn about common functional groups: alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, and carboxylic acids.

steps.title: Building Molecules
steps.content: Construct simple organic molecules like methanol and ethanol.

steps.title: Properties
steps.content: Observe how functional groups affect physical properties like boiling point and solubility.

title: Spectroscopy Fundamentals
description: Learn how to interpret UV-Vis, IR, and NMR spectra

steps.title: Introduction to Spectroscopy
steps.content: Spectroscopy reveals molecular structure by analyzing how molecules interact with light.

steps.title: IR Spectroscopy
steps.content: IR spectra show characteristic peaks for different bonds. C=O appears around 1700 cm⁻¹.

steps.title: UV-Vis Spectroscopy
steps.content: UV-Vis shows electronic transitions. Aromatic compounds absorb around 250-280 nm.

steps.title: NMR Spectroscopy
steps.content: NMR reveals the hydrogen environment. Chemical shift, integration, and splitting patterns tell the structure.

title: Quantum Mechanics in Chemistry
description: Understanding electron orbitals and quantum behavior

steps.title: Wave-Particle Duality
steps.content: Electrons behave as both waves and particles. This explains atomic structure.

steps.title: Atomic Orbitals
steps.content: Electrons occupy orbitals (s, p, d, f) with specific shapes and energies.

steps.title: Molecular Orbitals
steps.content: When atoms bond, atomic orbitals combine to form molecular orbitals (HOMO and LUMO).

steps.title: Electronic Transitions
steps.content: Light absorption promotes electrons from HOMO to LUMO, giving molecules color.

title: pH and Acid-Base Chemistry
description: Master acids, bases, and pH calculations

steps.title: What is pH?
steps.content: pH measures acidity from 0-14. pH 7 is neutral, <7 is acidic, >7 is basic.

steps.title: Strong Acids
steps.content: Create hydrochloric acid (HCl) and observe complete dissociation.

steps.title: Weak Acids
steps.content: Create acetic acid and see partial dissociation. pKa determines acid strength.

steps.title: Titration
steps.content: Neutralize an acid with a base and observe the pH change.
